name: Pythagorean FDOSM Extension for SLRS Benchmarking
description: A Pythagorean-fuzzy FDOSM-based evaluation methodology for benchmarking sign language recognition systems.
notes: Specialized, non-LLM benchmark focused on sign-language/gesture recognition metrics using Pythagorean-fuzzy FDOSM; results depend strongly on chosen fuzzy parameters and modalities (video/sensor). Not widely adopted as a standard benchmark and may be sensitive to dataset size and annotation variability.
